reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: Expired-owner recovery now SIGKILLs a frozen or hung execution worker (lease lapsed beyond the grace margin, failed liveness call, pidfd-verified birth, whole session) and the supervisor reaps exited worker children. Selected: the auto-recovery initiation suite, the real detached-process suite (frozen worker with a grandchild, API/responsive/unverified workers never killed, exited worker reaped), process identity, and orphan recovery, on SQLite and PostgreSQL.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright layer: no operator-visible interface changed. Recovery timing was measured end to end on a fake scratch Core (SIGSTOP forever, SIGSTOP then SIGKILL, SIGSTOP then SIGCONT).
